gap: Construct validity of time-sensitive legal QA evaluation is unexamined: the only version-aware statutory benchmark is fully LLM-generated (697 generated pairs, 312 expert-accepted) with LLM-judged answers, so it is unknown whether measured improvements reflect real retrieval behaviour on amended law or artifacts of the generator and judge.

evidence.quote: From a total of 697 generated pairs, 312 were accepted.
LLM-as-a-judge validated against human expert ratings

why_unaddressed: Benchmark construction and evaluation are both LLM-driven with expert screening, and no retrieved work reports the agreement between synthetic-item rankings and independent real-query rankings for this task.
research_question: Do improvements measured on synthetic, LLM-generated time-sensitive legal QA items transfer to real time-stamped legal queries, or are they artifacts of generation and LLM judging?
potential_experiment: Compare model rankings on synthetic benchmark items against a small human-annotated or historically sourced set of real time-stamped legal queries, and include a content-blind date-only baseline to quantify how much score is attributable to timestamps alone.
verification_required: Requires access to real time-stamped legal queries (e.g. logs or published point-in-time research questions) and a human-annotated audit sample.
